senses.gloss:
ind.
Therefore, thence, the consequent or correlative to यत्.
E.
तन to spread or extend, affix क्विप्.

ind.
Thenceforth.
E.
ततस्, and प्रभृति the rest.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Spread, diffused, expanded.
2 Stretched, extended.
m. (-तः)
Air, wind.
n. (-तं)
Any stringed musical instrument.
E.
तन to spread, &c. क्त affix, or Uṇādi affix तन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Venerable, reverend, respectable.
m. (-तः)
1 A father.
2 A term of affection addressed to any person, but especially to a junior or inferior, as हे तात oh! child, &c.
E.
तन to extend, (his race or fame,) क्त affix, and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं)
Distinctly marked.
E.
तत, and चिह्न a mark.

f. (-त्री)
The plantain tree.
E.
तत spread, and पत्री a leaf, broad-leaved.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
That one, (of many.)
E.
तद् that, डतमच् affix of the superlative degree.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
That one, (of two.)
E.
तद् that, and डतरच् affix of the comparative degree.

ind.
1 Therefore, thence, consequently.
2 From that or then.
3 Then, how, (asking.)
4 Then, further, after that, (in continuation.)
5 Afterwards, subsequently.
6 Thither, there.
E.
तद् that, affix तसि.

ind.
1 Hither and thither.
2 Then, after that, what next; (asking impatiently.)
E.
ततस् reiterated.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
Of or relating to that, &c.
E.
ततस् as above, त्यप् aff.

mfn. plu. (ततयः ततयः ततीनि)
So many.

f. (-तिः)
1 A line, a row or range.
2 A number, a crowd.
E.
तन to spread, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-तिः)
A son.
E.
तन to spread, (the race,) ञि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Obeying, serving, a servant.
E.
तद्, and कर who does.

m. (-लः)
Present time, time being, or the time when an, act occurs.
E.
तत् that, काल time.

m. (-धीः)
A man wise or intelligent for the time being, one having presence of mind, &c.
E.
तत्काल time being, and धी understanding.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Working without hire or wages.
E.
तत् thence, क्रिया business.

n. (-णं)
Time present, time being.
E.
तद् that, and क्षण moment.

n. (-त्त्वं)
1 Essential nature, the real nature of the human soul, considered as one and the same with the divine spirit animating the universe: the philosophical etymology of this word best explains its meaning, तद् that, that divine being, and त्व thou, that very God art thou.
2 The Supreme Being, or BRAHMA.
3 Truth, reality, substance, opposed to what is illusory or fallacious.
4 An element or elementary property, differently enumerated in different systems, from the three which are the same with the three Guṇas, to twenty-seven, which include the elements, organs, faculties, matter, spirit, life, and God.
5 A first principle, an axiom.
6 Mind, intellect.
7 Slow time in music.
8 A musical instrument.
E.
as above, or तद that, thence, &c. affix त्व; the word is properly, therefore, written तत्त्व, but in books one त is commonly rejected.

n. (-त्वं)
See तत्त्व.

n. (-नं)
Knowledge of divine truth.
E.
तत्त्व as above, and ज्ञान knowledge.

ind.
Truly, accurately, fully.
E.
तत्त्व, and तसिल् aff.

m. (-सः)
Touching different parts of the body in the worship of VIṢṆU.
E.
तत्त्व, and न्यास gesticulation.

mfn. (-वित्)
Knowing the truth, knowing things as they are.
E.
तत्त्व, and विद् who knows.

m. (-धः)
Knowledge of spirit.
E.
तत्त्व, and अवबोध ascertainment.

m. (-गः)
A positive charge or declaration.
E.
तत्त्व, and अभियोग accusation.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Diligent, attending to any thing closely and anxiously.
2 Belonging to a principal object or intent of.
m. (-रः)
The thirtieth part of the time of the twinkling of the eye.
E.
तत् that, पर addicted to.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Attached or addicted to some particular thing or person.
E.
तद् that, परायण attached to.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Prior, former.
E.
तत्, and पूर्व्व before.

m. (-षः)
1 That or a certain person.
2 A form of composition, (in Grammar,) usually consisting of two nouns, the first of which was in any case except the nominative or vocative; sometimes the inflection of the case is retained.
E.
तत् that, and पुरुष man or person.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Resulting from any particular act, &c.
m. (-लः)
1 The white-water lily.
3 A fragrant grass.
E.
तद्, and फल fruit.

(इ) तत्रि r. 10th cl. (तन्त्रयति)
1 To spread, to extend or expand.
2 To nourish or support a family, &c.

ind.
There, therein, the relative to अत्र.
E.
तद् that, त्रल् affix, in lieu of the proper seventh case.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Produced there or in a certain place.
E.
तत्र, and त्यप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Venerable, respectable, reverend.
E.
तत्र therein, (in all things,) भवत् preeminent: see अत्रभवत्.

mfn. (-गुः-गूः-गु)
Paternal, relating or belonging to the father.
m. (-गुः)
A paternal uncle.
E.
तात a father, गु who goes or is, from गम to go, with डु aff.

f. du. always (-त्र्यौ)
Father and mother, parents.
E.
तात father, and जनयित्री mother.

m. (-ल्यः)
A paternal uncle, or the most respectable of the male relations.
E.
तात a father, and तुल्य like, equal to.

m. (-नः)
A wagtail.

m. (-लः)
1 A fatherly relative, one who may be considered as a father.
2 Sickness, disease.
3 An iron club or spike.
4 Cooking or maturing.
5 Heat, physical or morbid.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to any particular moment of time.
E.
तत्काल, and ठक् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Object, purpose, intent, design.
2 Meaning, purport.
2 Explanation.
E.
तत्पर intent, यञ् aff.

m. (-र्थः)
The meaning or purpose of a sentence.
E.
तात्पर्य्य purpose, and अर्थ meaning.
